description: FHIR R4 Organization resource — a formally or informally recognized grouping of people or organizations formed for the purpose of achieving some form of collective action.

fields.label: Resource ID
fields.description: The logical id of the resource, as used in the URL for the resource.

fields.label: Identifier
fields.description: Identifies this organization across multiple systems.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Whether the organization's record is still in active use.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: The kind(s) of organization that this is.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: A name used for the organization.

fields.label: Alias
fields.description: A list of alternate names that the organization is known as, or was known as in the past.

fields.label: Telecom
fields.description: A contact detail for the organization.

fields.label: Part Of
fields.description: The organization of which this organization forms a part. Reference to Organization.

fields.label: Contact
fields.description: Contact for the organization for a certain purpose.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the organization. Reference to Endpoint.
